CASES.DESCRIPTION: Every chat an agent takes is one case, opened automatically and linked to its thread. A case's status is its chat's status, and a customer writing back reopens the same case.
CASES.EMPTY_STATE: No cases here yet. A case opens automatically when an agent takes a chat.
CASES.MINE_HINT: Cases you own and cases from chats you replied in, including solved and closed ones.

EDIT.TITLE: Edit case {display}
EDIT.DESCRIPTION: Change the subject, severity or team. The status and owner follow the chat.
EDIT.ERROR: Could not update the case, please try again
EDIT.FETCH_ERROR: Could not load the case, please try again

RELATED.EMPTY: No cases yet. One opens automatically when an agent takes this chat.
